target_customer: Foodservice buyers such as poke bars and restaurants, then retail and direct to consumer shoppers wanting plant-based sushi grade seafood
problem: Fish supply is unsustainable and existing plant-based seafood tasted and performed poorly versus raw tuna and salmon.
business_model: CPG and foodservice product sales of plant-based tuna and smoked salmon, wholesale and direct to consumer

founders.name: Jacek Prus
founders.background_notes: YC page says he stood up manufacturing lines and ran capital projects; the only founder listed.

competitors.name: Sophie's Kitchen
competitors.what: Plant-based toona made from Japanese yam

competitors.name: Ocean Hugger Foods
competitors.what: Tomato based Ahimi raw tuna alternative

competitors.name: Good Catch Foods
competitors.what: Plant-based tuna launched at Whole Foods and Thrive Market

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching raw tuna and salmon texture and flavor with plants and fermentation, then scaling through co-manufacturers, was hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Recipes and process know how offered limited protection and several rivals already sold plant-based tuna; manufacturing and brand were the edges.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it; Wicked Kitchen, a plant-based brand, acquired it in an all stock deal in May 2023.

market_need_then: Plant-based meat had mainstream traction (Beyond, Impossible) and seafood analogs were about 1.4% of plant-based meat sales, per Good Food Institute data cited in a trade report, so the need was an open gap with small current spend.

branding.name_origin: Launched as Kuleana; renamed Current Foods in February 2022 with press copy playing on bringing the future of sustainable eating to the current. Meaning of Kuleana not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Sustainability and 'Beyond Meat of seafood' positioning

branding.brand_signature: Kuleana tuna, named among TIME's 100 Best Inventions of 2021 per a headline on the YC page

rebrands.why: Coincided with the move into direct to consumer sales

branding.community_and_virality: Celebrity investor Chris Paul and TIME recognition drew press; no fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong press for a young brand (TIME listing, celebrity backer) and reach of 2,000 plus retail stores per the YC page, but the rename in 2022 reset awareness and sources show no consumer following.

pivots.from: Foodservice focus under the Kuleana name
pivots.to: Current Foods brand adding direct to consumer and retail
pivots.why: Expand beyond restaurants into retail and online delivery

outcome_analysis: Current Foods built a plant-based tuna and salmon brand, raised an $18M seed in June 2022 and reached retail, but alternative seafood remained a small category. Wicked Kitchen acquired it for stock in May 2023, its second seafood acquisition in a year, which looks like consolidation of a sub scale category rather than a breakout win.
notes: CB Insights lists about 18.65M over five rounds; only the 18M seed is sourced. The YC bio says 25M raised, unverified. Competitor sources are undated in the search results and likely 2019 to 2020. The deal was all stock with terms undisclosed. The YC page says the company was founded 2019 under the Kuleana name.
